ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aarti Surfactants Limited has submitted a routine compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This confirms that its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, MUFG Intime India Private Limited, properly processed all dematerialization requests, ensuring securities were listed and the register of members updated within prescribed timelines. The document indicates sound operational adherence to investor protection regulations concerning shareholder records and electronic share conversion, with no red flags identified.
